title: Service bindings
claim: Service bindings enable private Worker-to-Worker calls, and Cloudflare Access context does not propagate through HTTP or RPC service-binding invocations.

title: REST API endpoints for pull request review comments
claim: A review-comment reply targets a top-level comment, and review-comment records expose user, commit, and reply-relation facts for verification.

title: REST API endpoints for pull request reviews
claim: The create-review API accepts a commit ID, review body, review event, and inline comments, with COMMENT, REQUEST_CHANGES, and APPROVE review events.

title: Getting started with Linear GraphQL
claim: Linear issueUpdate accepts a stateId, and clients must inspect GraphQL errors even when the HTTP response is 200.

title: OAuth actor authorization
claim: OAuth actor authorization can attribute API actions to the installed app rather than the authorizing user.

title: Webhooks
claim: Linear signs the raw webhook body with HMAC-SHA256, requires HTTP 200, treats responses slower than five seconds as failures, and retries failed deliveries with backoff.
